item.title: Google Launches Open Speech Dataset to Expand AI for African Languages
item.description: Google, working with research institutions across Africa, has introduced WAXAL, an open-access speech dataset designed to improve artificial intelligence technologies for African languages. The dataset includes voice samples from 21 Sub-Saharan African languages, among them Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, Luganda, Swahili and Acholi. item.title: Kenyan Activists Seek Court Halt on Deployment of “High-Risk” AI Systems
